auditTitle: FortiX Platform Security Hardening & Isolation Audit

authentication.mechanism: JWT Access Tokens + Refresh Token Rotation with bcrypt secret hashing
authentication.findings: Tokens require active signing secrets; invalid signatures rejected.

authorizationAndTenantIsolation.mechanism: Multi-tenant project scoping with requireProjectOwnership middleware and SQL row filtering
authorizationAndTenantIsolation.findings: Cross-project access strictly rejected on routes, keys, metrics, topology, and reports.

ssrfAndDnsSecurity.mechanism: Strict SecurityGuard with asynchronous DNS resolution, IPv4/IPv6 classification, hex/octal decoding, and cloud metadata blocking

rateLimiting.mechanism: Distributed Atomic Lua Token Bucket in Redis with fallback to in-memory sliding window
rateLimiting.findings: Maintains strict token quotas and fails closed/safe during infrastructure degradation.

cryptographicSignatures.mechanism: HMAC-SHA256 timestamped signatures with replay tolerance windows on outbound webhooks
cryptographicSignatures.findings: Tampered payloads and expired timestamps rejected.

artifactStorageIntegrity.mechanism: SHA-256 integrity checksums, multi-tenant directory partitioning, and authorized download routes
artifactStorageIntegrity.findings: Artifacts stored with verified SHA-256 hashes and download authorization.
